notes: Form 425 filed as an 8-K (Item 1.01) by RMR Mortgage Trust announcing a stock-for-stock merger of Tremont Mortgage Trust into RMR Mortgage Trust (renamed Seven Hills Realty Capital, new ticker SHRC). Kind chosen as equity_mna, not merger: the agreement says RMRM operated as an investment company under the Investment Company Act only before January 5, 2021 and as a mortgage REIT from then on, and TRMT is a Maryland REIT, so neither party is a fund or BDC at signing; a reviewer applying 'merger' to any 425 would differ. fund_type reit on the same basis. subject_tickers: only RMRM is printed as a ticker; 'TRMT' appears only as a defined abbreviation for Tremont Mortgage Trust, so it is not listed. Conditions (2) RMRM shareholder approval of the share issuance is a second shareholder_approval item, covered by the one category. termination_fee: each party's fee is $2,156,000 plus expenses (the 8-K text says $2.156 million); the value is the TRMT (target) fee from the agreement's definitions. Shareholder meeting and record dates are not stated in this excerpt.
